sql: SELECT player_id, full_name FROM players WHERE position ILIKE '%goalkeeper%' AND height_cm > 190
SELECT player_id, full_name FROM players WHERE position ILIKE '%defender%' AND height_cm < 175
SELECT player_id, full_name FROM players WHERE position ILIKE '%midfielder%' AND nationality = 'France'
SELECT player_id, full_name FROM players WHERE position ILIKE '%forward%' AND nationality = 'Brazil'

query: Players with more than 10 career goals
sql: SELECT player_id, full_name FROM players WHERE career_goals > 10

query: Players with at least 5 career assists
sql: SELECT player_id, full_name FROM players WHERE career_assists >= 5
SELECT DISTINCT p.player_id, p.full_name FROM players p JOIN player_club_history pch on p.player_id = pch.player_id JOIN clubs c on pch.club_id = c.club_id WHERE c.club_name = 'Manchester United'
SELECT player_id, full_name FROM players WHERE age < 21
SELECT player_id, full_name FROM players WHERE position ILIKE '%defender%' AND nationality = 'Germany' AND age > 30
SELECT player_id, full_name FROM players WHERE position ILIKE '%goalkeeper%' AND nationality = 'England'
SELECT player_id, full_name FROM players WHERE joined_season = '2023'

query: Players whose preferred foot is left
sql: SELECT player_id, full_name FROM players WHERE preferred_foot = 'Left'
SELECT player_id, full_name FROM players WHERE height_cm > 195
SELECT DISTINCT p.player_id, p.full_name FROM players p JOIN season_statistics s ON p.player_id = s.player_id WHERE s.season_id = 2022
SELECT player_id, full_name FROM players WHERE nationality = 'Belgium' AND position ILIKE '%midfielder%' AND age < 25
SELECT player_id, full_name FROM players WHERE position ILIKE '%forward%' AND total_appearances > 5

query: Players with more than 300 minutes played in any season
sql: SELECT DISTINCT p.player_id, p.full_name FROM players p JOIN season_statistics s ON p.player_id = s.player_id WHERE s.minutes_played > 300

query: Players from Spain with over 5 goals
sql: SELECT player_id, full_name FROM players WHERE nationality = 'Spain' AND career_goals > 5

query: French players who played for Arsenal
sql: SELECT DISTINCT p.player_id, p.full_name FROM players p JOIN player_club_history pch on p.player_id = pch.player_id JOIN clubs c on pch.club_id = c.club_id WHERE c.club_name = 'Arsenal' and p.nationality = 'France'

query: Players with at least 2 yellow cards
sql: SELECT DISTINCT p.player_id, p.full_name FROM players p JOIN season_statistics s ON p.player_id = s.player_id WHERE s.yellow_cards >= 2

query: Players who had more than 10 dribbles
sql: SELECT DISTINCT p.player_id, p.full_name FROM players p JOIN season_statistics s ON p.player_id = s.player_id WHERE s.dribbles_completed > 10

query: Players with more than 5 tackles in a season
sql: SELECT DISTINCT p.player_id, p.full_name FROM players p JOIN season_statistics s ON p.player_id = s.player_id WHERE s.tackles > 5
SELECT player_id, full_name FROM players WHERE nationality = 'Netherlands' AND position ILIKE '%defender%'
SELECT player_id, full_name FROM players ORDER BY age ASC LIMIT 10
SELECT player_id, full_name FROM players ORDER BY age DESC LIMIT 10

query: Spanish midfielders with fewer than 3 assists
sql: SELECT player_id, full_name FROM players WHERE nationality = 'Spain' AND position ILIKE '%midfielder%' AND career_assists < 3
SELECT player_id, full_name FROM players WHERE nationality = 'Brazil' AND age < 25

query: Goalkeepers with more than 5 clean sheets
sql: SELECT player_id, full_name FROM players WHERE position ILIKE '%goalkeeper%' AND total_goals = 0 AND total_appearances >= 5

query: Players with more than 200 completed passes
sql: SELECT DISTINCT p.player_id, p.full_name FROM players p JOIN season_statistics s ON p.player_id = s.player_id WHERE s.passes_completed > 200

query: Players who committed more than 5 fouls
sql: SELECT DISTINCT p.player_id, p.full_name FROM players p JOIN season_statistics s ON p.player_id = s.player_id WHERE s.fouls_committed > 5
